  </mj-column>
</mj-section>

recipes.name: Product launch
recipes.notes: Lead with the hero shot for impact, explain the new thing with key facts, show a detail photo, then drive to one CTA before closing.

recipes.name: Back in stock
recipes.notes: The hero shot confirms it's back, the centered band delivers the emotional 'why people love it' punch, then one CTA closes fast since the message is simple.

recipes.name: Win-back
recipes.notes: Opens with a personal text headline and reminder, uses a highlighted band for the compelling reason to return, then grounds it with a product shot before the CTA.

recipes.name: Seasonal / holiday
recipes.notes: A strong seasonal hero image sets mood, short copy ties it to the occasion, and a single CTA band keeps focus even if an offer is added.

recipes.name: Welcome
recipes.notes: Story-first text block welcomes and introduces the brand, three columns highlight differentiators, then a bestseller photo and CTA convert the goodwill into a shop action.

recipes.name: New collection
recipes.notes: Hero establishes the collection visually, two even columns showcase paired products with captions, and one CTA sends everyone to the full collection.

recipes.name: Product spotlight
recipes.notes: The hero shot anchors the single product, three feature blocks each pair a fact with a photo, and the CTA band closes with one clear action.

recipes.name: Cart reminder
recipes.notes: The product photo with name/price reminds them what they left, the highlighted band reassures with shipping/care points, then the CTA nudges completion.

recipes.name: Newsletter
recipes.notes: Nav header sets it up as a mini landing page, intro text transitions into the main article with sidebar links, then categorized resources and social links close it out.

recipes.name: Announcement
recipes.notes: A bold hero image grabs attention for the news, supporting text explains the details, and a single CTA band drives the one key action.
